title: web: reports, ranking, troop training panel, unread badge
criteria:
Follow the VIEW CONTRACT (export async function render(el, ctx, params); ctx = { meta, state, village, villageId, toast, refresh, navigate }; params = { id, query }). DOM only via h()/clear() from ../dom.js (never innerHTML).

== web/js/views/reports.js (routes #/reports and #/reports/:id) ==
List (#/reports, params.id undefined): heading 'รายงาน'; fetch `api.get('/reports')` (list of {id, kind, title, created_at, is_read}); one clickable `.list-row` per report: title (bold, class 'unread', when is_read is false) and fmtTime(created_at); click -> ctx.navigate('#/reports/' + id); 'ไม่มีรายงาน' when empty.
Detail (#/reports/:id): `api.get('/reports/' + params.id)` -> {id, kind, title, created_at, is_read, data}; a button 'กลับไปรายการ' (navigates to '#/reports'); title as heading + time. After the fetch dispatch `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reports-read'))` once. Render by kind: 'battle' -> a banner 'ฝ่ายโจมตีชนะ' when data.attacker_won else 'ฝ่ายโจมตีแพ้' (class negative for the loser banner); 'พลังโจมตี <fmtNum(data.attack_power)>' and 'พลังป้องกัน <fmtNum(data.defense_power)>'; a table 'ผู้โจมตี' (player name, village name, columns หน่วย / จำนวน / ตาย with rows from data.attacker.units and .losses using unit name_th from ctx.meta.units); one table per entry of data.defenders titled 'ผู้ป้องกัน' + player name (same columns), or the line 'ไม่มีผู้ป้องกัน' when the list is empty; 'ของที่ปล้นได้' with the 4 loot values (labels ไม้ หิน เหล็ก อาหาร, fmtNum); 'กำแพงเลเวล <before> -> <after>' when data.wall.before != data.wall.after. 'scout' -> 'สอดแนมสำเร็จ' or 'สอดแนมไม่สำเร็จ' (success flag); when successful show 'ทรัพยากร' (4 values), 'ทหารในหมู่บ้าน' (units list or 'ไม่มีทหาร'), 'กำแพงเลเวล <n>' and 'อาคาร' as a compact list of name_th + level (ctx.meta.buildings). 'reinforce' -> a line with the units list (name_th x count). 'info' -> when data.killed exists: 'ทหารที่ตาย' + units list; when data.winner exists: 'ผู้ชนะ <winner.name>', 'อันดับของคุณ <your_rank>' and the top list (rank, name, population). Unknown shapes just show the title.

== web/js/views/ranking.js (route #/ranking) ==
Heading 'อันดับ'; `api.get('/ranking')` -> rows {rank, player_id, name, tribe, is_bot, villages, population}; a table with columns 'อันดับ', 'ชื่อ', 'เผ่า' (name_th from ctx.meta.tribes), 'หมู่บ้าน', 'ประชากร'; the row whose player_id == ctx.state.player.id gets class 'me'; bots show a small 'bot' tag after the name.

== web/js/views/slotpanel.js (EDIT, keep every existing export working) ==
Inside openSlotPanel, when the slot has a current building: fetch `api.get('/villages/' + ctx.villageId + '/train-options')` (list of {unit, name_th, building, cost, time_s, missing, max_affordable}) and keep the options whose `building` equals current.type; when there are any, add to the sheet a section with heading 'ฝึกทหาร': per unit a block with name_th, the four costs (same cost rows helper as for building costs, .negative when not enough), the time per unit via fmtDuration, the missing requirements (.negative lines), a number input labelled 'จำนวน' (min 1, default 1, max = max_affordable when > 0), the text 'ฝึกได้สูงสุด <max_affordable>' and a primary button 'ฝึก' disabled when missing is not empty or max_affordable is 0; click -> `api.post('/villages/' + ctx.villageId + '/train', {unit, count})`, ctx.toast('เริ่มฝึกแล้ว'), `await ctx.refresh()`; ApiError -> ctx.toast(err.message, true) and re-enable. Also a 'คิวฝึกทหาร' list of the entries of ctx.village.training whose building equals current.type: '<unit name_th>: <count_done>/<count_total>' with `<span class="countdown" data-countdown=next_at>`; 'ไม่มีคิวฝึก' when none. A failing train-options fetch must not break the rest of the panel (ignore the error silently).

== web/js/app.js (EDIT minimally) ==
Show the unread count on the 'รายงาน' nav link (the 4th .nav-link): text 'รายงาน' plus ' (<n>)' when ctx state.unread_reports > 0 (update it in updateTopbar/updateNav every time state changes and on first load). Listen for `window` event 'reports-read': refetch GET /state (without re-rendering the current view), update `state`, and refresh only the badge/top bar. Do not change anything else in app.js.

== web/css/style.css ==
APPEND a new section '/* reports + ranking + training */' at the END: `.unread` (bold), `.list-row.clickable` (cursor pointer, hover background), tables (`.table` full width, bordered rows, small font), `tr.me` highlight, `.tag` small pill, `.banner` big result banner. Do not modify existing rules.
notes:
- Thai strings: use ONLY the strings written in single quotes in this task (copy letter by letter; they were proofread; typical mistakes to avoid: 'บ่าน' for 'บ้าน', 'ท่ี' for 'ที่', 'น้ี' for 'นี้', 'สุม' for 'สุ่ม', doubled tone marks). Do not type any other Thai.
- Resource labels: ไม้, หิน, เหล็ก, อาหาร for wood, stone, iron, food.
- Imports as in the other views: `import { h, clear } from '../dom.js'; import { api, ApiError } from '../api.js'; import { fmtNum, fmtDuration, fmtTime } from '../format.js'; import { countdown } from '../clock.js';`
- unit/building names: ctx.meta.units[key].name_th and ctx.meta.buildings[key].name_th (fall back to the key).
- In slotpanel.js reuse the existing helpers (costRows etc.); do not change the building/upgrade behaviour.
- Run the test_cmd (node --check on every js file) and fix syntax errors.
